generated.as: CASE WHEN "delegation_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 'merge' END

gate_decisions_delegated_approves_merge.name: gate_decisions_delegated_approves_merge
gate_decisions_delegated_approves_merge.value: "gate_decisions"."delegation_id" IS NULL OR ("gate_decisions"."decision" = 'approve' AND "gate_decisions"."evidence" ->> 'connector' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'merge')

harness_items_lease_only_when_held.name: harness_items_lease_only_when_held
harness_items_lease_only_when_held.value: "harness_items"."lease_expires" IS NULL OR "harness_items"."claimed_by" IS NOT NULL

harness_items_person_has_no_lease.name: harness_items_person_has_no_lease
harness_items_person_has_no_lease.value: "harness_items"."claimant_kind" IS DISTINCT FROM 'person' OR "harness_items"."lease_expires" IS NULL

harness_items_issue_whole.name: harness_items_issue_whole
harness_items_issue_whole.value: ("harness_items"."issue_repo" IS NULL) = ("harness_items"."issue_number" IS NULL) AND ("harness_items"."issue_number" IS NULL) = ("harness_items"."issue_github_id" IS NULL)

harness_runs_subscription_has_no_cost.name: harness_runs_subscription_has_no_cost
harness_runs_subscription_has_no_cost.value: "harness_runs"."cost_basis" <> 'subscription' OR ("harness_runs"."cost_minor" IS NULL AND "harness_runs"."compute_minor" IS NULL)

page_comments_quote_bounded.name: page_comments_quote_bounded
page_comments_quote_bounded.value: "page_comments"."quote" IS NULL OR length(btrim("page_comments"."quote")) BETWEEN 1 AND 500

columns.expression: (setweight(to_tsvector('english', "title"), 'A') || setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce("frontmatter"->>'jd_id', '') || ' ' || coalesce("frontmatter"->>'overview', '') || ' ' || coalesce("frontmatter"->'tags', '[]'::jsonb)::text || ' ' || coalesce("frontmatter"->'aliases', '[]'::jsonb)::text), 'B') || setweight(to_tsvector('english', left("body_md", 500000)), 'D'))

role_grants_area_matches_scope.name: role_grants_area_matches_scope
role_grants_area_matches_scope.value: ("role_grants"."scope_kind" = 'org' AND "role_grants"."scope_area" IS NULL) OR ("role_grants"."scope_kind" = 'jd_area' AND "role_grants"."scope_area" IS NOT NULL AND "role_grants"."scope_area" ~ '^([0-9])0-\1[9]$')

credential_access_log_reason_matches.name: credential_access_log_reason_matches
credential_access_log_reason_matches.value: ("credential_access_log"."outcome" = 'done' AND "credential_access_log"."reason" IS NULL) OR ("credential_access_log"."outcome" = 'refused' AND "credential_access_log"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND "credential_access_log"."reason" IN ('not_permitted', 'credential_revoked', 'credential_expired', 'value_not_storable', 'credential_malformed', 'key_rejected', 'key_service_refused', 'key_service_unavailable', 'key_service_not_configured', 'ciphertext_rejected', 'envelope_malformed'))

credential_grants_second_is_another_pers.name: credential_grants_second_is_another_person
credential_grants_second_is_another_pers.value: ("credential_grants"."second_by" IS NULL AND "credential_grants"."second_at" IS NULL) OR ("credential_grants"."second_required" AND "credential_grants"."second_by" IS NOT NULL AND "credential_grants"."second_at" IS NOT NULL AND "credential_grants"."second_by" <> "credential_grants"."granted_by")

credentials_ref_inside_area.name: credentials_ref_inside_area
credentials_ref_inside_area.value: "credentials"."jd_ref" IS NULL OR ("credentials"."jd_ref" ~ '^[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]{2})?$' AND left("credentials"."jd_ref", 1) = left("credentials"."jd_area", 1))
